source: Q2 findings matrix, R4 reconciliation, R5-R1/R5-R2/R5-R3 reconciliation records

findings.originalRequirement: Provider fixture and resolver outcome use the upstream envelope; malformed shared input must not pass.
findings.remediation: R4 provider fixture and harness controls; R5 unchanged.
findings.independentVerification: C-16 (3 cases) and C-17 (3 cases) pass on all six independent cells; self-test malformed-shared-input-cannot-pass passes; FCN-01 observations match.

findings.originalRequirement: Native-failure and lifecycle scenarios must be executed in isolated processes with real interventions.
findings.remediation: R4 lifecycle probe; R5 C-26 cases.
findings.independentVerification: C-26 lifecycle controls pass on all six cells (missing, mismatched, wrong-RID, incompatible, resident); Windows self-test invalid-ABI path passes; macOS hosted Verify native selftest passes.

findings.originalRequirement: C-23 compatibility ceiling must be resolved or explicitly bounded.
findings.remediation: ED-06 approval in R4; ED-06 retired in R5-R2 after the corrected reference.
findings.independentVerification: Eight typed-context cases (two base, six alternate encodings) are clean Allow/Allow on the corrected reference and D3 on all six cells; the original register preserves ED-06 verbatim; the original reference still produces Deny (historical defect surface).
remainingLimitations: The original reference remains defective by design; it is retained only for historical reproducibility.

findings.originalRequirement: An errored forbid must preserve the raw Allow, the error and the forbid identity; it must not become a clean Deny.
findings.independentVerification: R3-C19-01 passes as a fail-closed raw Allow with error on all six cells.

findings.originalRequirement: A genuine temporal-engine evaluation failure must be demonstrated.
findings.remediation: R5-R3 owner acknowledgment of structural unreachability; C-14 discharged via FCN-03 and FCN-04.
findings.independentVerification: Pinned source confirms temporal.observe precedes temporal.evaluate; the only InMemoryTemporalEngine error is 'no event observed', unreachable for an observed decision event; eval_condition returns bool; Cedar 4.11.0/4.13.0 has no 'formerly'. FCN-03/04 pass on all cells.
remainingLimitations: The literal temporal-engine failure path remains unexecuted; the acceptance is limited to the pinned Dogwood 1.1.2 / Cedar 4.11.0 stack.

findings.originalRequirement: A bounded 1,000-character payload must be compared by value.
findings.independentVerification: C-24-04 passes on all six cells.

findings.originalRequirement: Semantic family coverage and required controls must be enforced on both sides.
findings.remediation: R5-R1 family-role enforcement and negative controls.
findings.independentVerification: 26/26 families covered; every required control present; 19/19 harness self-tests pass on both TFMs, including false family pass, vacuous agreement, stage-mismatch and scope-masking negatives.
remainingLimitations: Self-test executes on Windows only (finding Q3-F07).

findings.originalRequirement: Evidence manifests must match a clean checkout byte-for-byte.
findings.remediation: R4 blob-based manifest; R5-R3 partial regression.
findings.independentVerification: FAILED. The R5-R3 manifests hash CRLF working-tree bytes and one covered file was changed after signing; 19/47 top-level entries match blobs and 1 is stale.
remainingLimitations: A clean LF checkout cannot verify either R5-R3 manifest.

findings.originalRequirement: Hosted CI and baseline identities must be bound to the reviewed subject.
findings.remediation: R4 hosted bindings; R5-R3/R5-R4 run records.
findings.independentVerification: Producer terminal run 46005380010 head is 12a4555; handoff aa31995 is its two-commit documentation-only child; independent run 46027320360 and 46027941574 are bound to aa31995.

findings.originalRequirement: The implementation delta must be fully inventoried.
findings.remediation: R3/R4 delta inventory; R5-R4 handoff diff.
findings.independentVerification: 12a4555..aa31995 is five documentation files only; the 87-commit R5-R3..R5-R4 remediation campaign is outside the handoff diff and is covered by the independent regression run.
findings.finalDisposition: Verified for the handoff; historical fixture change is Q3-F10

findings.originalRequirement: Diagnostic normalization must not depend on non-normative message wording.
findings.independentVerification: The 124-case categories are stable on all six cells; a wording change would surface as an unexpected difference, not a silent pass.
remainingLimitations: A pinned-engine wording change could move a diagnostic between categories.

findings.originalRequirement: Five production-suite gaps must be reconciled without silent resolution.
findings.remediation: R5-R2 reconciliation; C-11 controls added; C-21 controls.
findings.independentVerification: Five gaps retain original ratings (diagnostic ID Low, duplicate IDs Low, caller action-entity conflict Medium, multi-action appliesTo Low, CurrentLoggedJson Low). C-11 has 13 cases and C-21 has 6 cases across the corpus, all passing.
remainingLimitations: Gap 3 remains Medium; the others remain Low.

findings.originalRequirement: The name-based InternalsVisibleTo grant must be assessed.
findings.independentVerification: src/DogwoodSharp/DogwoodSharp.csproj still grants InternalsVisibleTo('PrepProbe'); the evidence probe uses that internal surface.
remainingLimitations: Any assembly named PrepProbe can reach the internal export/lower surface.

findings.originalRequirement: CurrentLoggedJson mirroring must be assessed against upstream temporal semantics.
findings.independentVerification: Temporal cases pass on all cells; no explicit production regression covers a non-empty logged record.
remainingLimitations: Non-empty CurrentLoggedJson semantics remain outside the corpus.

findings.originalRequirement: The capture engine's inability to surface upstream policy errors must be recorded.
findings.independentVerification: The D3 trusted-binding capture path returns synthetic Deny/no errors by construction; FCN-03/04 record the observed behavior.
remainingLimitations: Upstream policy errors inside the trusted binding are reported through the binding error channel.

findings.originalRequirement: Per-request re-lowering and managed/native residency must be bounded.
findings.independentVerification: The production API still retains source/schema/provider data for the request lifetime; no new persistence was introduced in the handoff.
remainingLimitations: Residency scales with the retained per-request lowering.

findings.originalRequirement: The ipaddr/datetime representability ceiling was an approved expected difference in R4.
findings.remediation: Corrected reference plus formal retirement in R5-R2.
findings.independentVerification: The two base cases and six alternate encodings are clean Allow on both sides on all six cells; the original register still carries ED-06; the patched api.rs hash matches the recorded identity.
findings.finalDisposition: Retired from the active contract, preserved historically

findings.originalRequirement: History-event policy-evaluation divergence between the reference and D3 must be decided.
findings.remediation: Owner contract decision; FCN-05 for TC-03..TC-06.
findings.independentVerification: Seven controls independently reproduced on both TFMs: TC-01/02/07 agreement; TC-03..06 stage-only fail-closed divergence with no decision; the original single-case OQ-01 reproduces D3 Allow vs reference failure.
findings.finalDisposition: FCN-05 formalized for TC-03..TC-06; original case remains unregistered (Q3-F05)
remainingLimitations: The original Allow-versus-failure case is outside FCN-05 and has no ED/FCN row.
